settings.openingLine: Press the seal when you are ready.
settings.letterLead: I made this so you would have a place that is only yours. Not a chat, and not a story that disappears. A thing you can open.
settings.finaleLine: Happy birthday. I am glad the day is yours.

notes.body: The photographs and the films are further down. They are days I wanted to keep somewhere better than a camera roll.
If you are early, the last page will wait with you until the day begins. If you are right on time, then good morning.
